objectives.description: Redeploy (deploy-headless.sh) and run the complete gate set with explicit source-store TARGET; gate 27 passes clean; two fast-gate failures (shellcheck in lean extension, dead-command-recommendation in memory extension) confirmed pre-existing/unrelated and recorded

Scoped run-all.sh --only over the 71-file migrated family (70 migrated + the new lint's own suite) against the freshly-deployed tree found and fixed a genuine Phase-8-discovered regression: test-lint-subject-resolution-declaration.sh's own Case 6 fixture hardcoded a now-drained migration-pending allowlist path (test-force-phases.sh); retargeted at the permanent exemption test-common-lib.sh. Also found and recorded as pre-existing/unrelated: test-task-type-detect.sh's structural [-f]-on-a-directory bug in its REAL_EXT_ROOT fallback branch, and test-lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh's 3 classification-data mismatches (none in this task's scope)

Final redeploy and full source-store-target gate set confirming no new failures beyond the enumerated known-unrelated set plus the issues recorded this phase. Final verify-deploy.sh (full, explicit TARGET): 3 of 42 failed -- gate 8 (test-postflight-deploy-gate.sh, test-redeploy-checkpoint-promotion.sh, test-task-type-detect.sh, test-lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh, plus the originally-enumerated test-detect-noop-bash.sh/test-four-tier-conflict.sh/test-guard-git-push.sh), gate 22 (shellcheck, lean extension), gate 24 (dead-command-recommendation, memory extension) -- all confirmed pre-existing/unrelated. Gate 27 PASSES. Scoped run-all.sh over the 71-file migrated family: 67 passed, 4 failed (all 4 confirmed pre-existing). grep -c '[SUBJECT]' across all 71 suites run individually: 164 total declaration lines, confirming every suite in the family declares its subject. Checkpoint divergence property confirmed live: a deploy-tree-first suite (test-issue-record.sh) now resolves the deployed copy; a hard-selected source-store suite (test-gate-out-derived-staleness.sh) still resolves the source-store copy regardless of deploy state
